currentContext.expansion: The Company operates manufacturing plants at Sira and Karaikal. During FY 2025-26 management undertook a comprehensive review of the approved production plan in light of geopolitical tension and conflict (Iran-America, Ukraine-Russia), changing domestic demand patterns, revised customer order forecasts, temporary raw material supply constraints, energy availability and emerging export opportunities. The revised plan is to produce high-value GVT and PGVT vitrified tiles in bigger sizes at the Sira plant and wall tiles at Karaikal, and the Company is planning to produce 60 cm x 60 cm vitrified tile at the Karaikal plant from 1 June 2026. The mix has already moved to larger formats: 60 x 120 cm rose to 53.47% of production in FY 2025-26 from 45.25%, and 80 x 160 cm to 2.62% from 1.41%, while 60 x 60 cm fell to 21.75% from 28.12%. The Directors' Report states the Company incurred capital expenditure of Rs. 5614.67 lakhs during the year, mainly on plant and machinery and building construction, and the MD&A attributes the rise in the debt-equity ratio to 'increase in new borrowings for new project'. The Company also continues energy-conservation investment (energy-efficient equipment, process improvements, monitoring) and adoption of digital printing, surface treatment and process automation technologies.
